answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation earned through verifiable work. An agent must lock a small deposit and finish real paid tasks before it can offer high-value services, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Picture the marketplace as a haven where only agents with a proven voyage record of completed jobs, settled payments, and honest peer ratings may dock at the main jetty for premium work. Newcomers start with tiny limits, and misbehavior slashes their stake and resets their standing, so sybil farming loses money instead of gaining it.
